data.titulo: Kipindi 2—Dilobe Kutūla ku Kunyongololwa mu Edipito
data.contenido:
I enka bantu mwanda kete bāpandile ku Dilobe, inoko mwenda mafuku kibalwa kya bantu kyēlundile’ko, bāikala tununu ne tununu. Kupwa kwa myaka 352 kupwa kwa Dilobe, Abalahama wābutulwa. Tukamona mwāfikidije Leza mulao wandi na kupa Abalahama mwana mwana-mulume witwa bu Isake. Ebiya mu bana babidi ba Isake, Leza wātonga’mo Yakoba.

Yakoba wādi na kisaka kikatampe kya bana bana-balume 12 ne bana bana-bakaji. Bana 10 ba Yakoba bāshikilwe mwanabo nkasampe Yosefa, o mwanda bāmupoteje mu bupika mu Edipito. Mafuku pa kupita’po Yosefa wāikala ke muludiki mukatampe mu Edipito. Pāikele’ko kipupo kya nzala, Yosefa wātompa batutu wandi mwanda wa kuyuka shi abaalamuka pa mutyima. Kupwa, kisaka kya Yakoba, ko kunena’mba Bene Isalela, kyāvilukila mu Edipito. Byonso bino byālongekele myaka 290 kupwa kwa Abalahama kubutulwa.

Bene Isalela bāshikete mu Edipito mu bula bwa myaka 215 yālondele’po. Kupwa Yosefa wāfwa, bāikala ke bapika mu yoya ntanda’ya. Mwenda mafuku, Mosesa wābutulwa, kadi Leza wāmwingidija mwanda wa kunyongolola Bene Isalela mu Edipito. Mu kino KIPINDI 2 mudi mānga yālongekele umbula mwa myaka 857.

LE UYUKILE kintu kibajinji kyālongele Noa kitatyi kyaālupukile na kyandi kisaka mu safini? Wāpēne mulambu nansha kyabuntu kudi Leza. Enka na mowikimwena pa kifwatulo kidi kunshi’ki. Noa wāpēne kino kyabuntu kya banyema mwanda wa kufwija’ko Leza pa kukūla kisaka kyandi ku dilobe dikatampe.

Lelo ulanga’mba Yehova wāitabije kino kyabuntu? Eyo, wēkitabije. O mwanda Leza wālaile Noa’mba kakikonakanyapo monka ntanda na dilobe.



Na pano kala, nshi yāuma, ebiya Noa ne kisaka kyandi bāshilula būmi bupya panja pa safini. Leza wēbesela ne kwibasapwila’mba: ‘Mufwaninwe kubutula bana bavule. Bungi bwenu bufwaninwe kuvula enka ne bikekala bantu pano pa ntanda ponso.’

Inoko mwenda mafuku, bantu bādi padi ba kwivwana moyo amba kukekala dilobe dikwabo pamo bwa dino kitatyi kyobādi ba kwivwana mānga ya dino dilobe dikatampe. O mwanda, Leza wātūdile’ko kintu kampanda kya kuvuluja bantu mulao waālaile’mba kakikonakanyapo monka ntanda ku dilobe. Lelo uyukile kintu kyātūdile bu kya kwibavuluja? I nkongolo.

Nkongolo umwekanga pavule mu diulu shi mvula wapu kunoka, mwinya nao wātamba. Nkongolo ukokeja kwikala na misombelo mivule kadi isangaja kumona. Lelo kodi kala mumone nkongolo? Umwene uno udi pa kifwatulo?

Leza wānene’mba: ‘Nalaya amba nkikonakanyapo nansha dimo monka bantu ne banyema bonso na dilobe. Natūla nkongolo wami mu makumbi. Kadi kitatyi kikamweka nkongolo, ami nkamumonanga ne kuvuluka uno wami mulao.’

Penepo shi ubamone nkongolo, lelo ufwaninwe kukuvuluja kika? Eyo, ufwaninwe kukuvuluja mulao wālaile Leza amba nkikonakanyapo dikwabo nansha dimo ntanda na dilobe dikatampe.Ngalwilo 8:18-22; 9:9-17. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

MYAKA mivule yāpityile’po. Bana ba Noa bādi kebadi na bana bavule. Babo bana nabo bātama, bābutula bana bavule. Pano ne pano ntanda yāikalwa na bantu bangibangi kashā.

Mu bano bantu, mwādi ne Nimiloda, nkanununa wa Noa. Wādi nkuma-bibi wādi upoya ne kwipaya banyema ne bantu bene. Kadi Nimiloda wēbikikile aye mwine bu mulopwe mwanda wa kutādila bantu bakwabo. Leza kāloelelwepo Nimiloda. Mu kine kitatyi’kya, bantu bonso bādi besamba enka ludimi lumo. Nimiloda wādi usaka kwibakongela pa kyaba kimo mwanda wa ebaludike. Shi ke pano, lelo uyukile kyaālongele? Wāsapwidile bantu bōbake kibundi ne kiteba monka. Wibatale pa kifwatulo, aba kebo bafwatula matafwadi.

Yehova Leza kāsangedilepo luno lūbako. Leza wādi usaka bantu bekale pano pa ntanda ponso. Inoko bantu bānena’mba: ‘Twayai twishimikile kibundi ne kiteba kilakila, mutwe wakyo utenge ne mu madiulu mwine. Nabya tusa kutumba!’ Bantu bādi basaka kwitumbija abo bene, bapela kutumbija Leza.

Enka nenki, Leza wāimika mwingilo wabo wa lūbako lwa kiteba. Lelo uyukile mwawāimikile’o? I na kutonona bantu besambe mu kitulumukila ndimi mishileshile, kyaba kya kwisamba enka ludimi lumo. Bōbaki kebādipo kadi beumvwana abo bene na bene. O mwanda kyabo kibundi kyāinikilwe bu Babele, nansha Babiloni, kushintulula ko kunena’mba “Kavutakanya.”

Ponka’po, bantu bāshilula kwenda kulampe na Babele. Kibumbo kya bantu besamba ludimi lumo baenda kukashikatyila pamo pa kifuko kikwabo kya ntanda.Ngalwilo 10:1, 8-10; 11:1-9. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

BANTU bakwabo bākashikete pa kyaba kitelwa bu Ulu, pa kupwa kwa Dilobe. Ulu wāikala ke kibundi kikatampe kya mobo mayampe shē. Inoko bantu ba mu kino kibundi bādi batōta baleza ba bubela. Kadi bālongele enka uno muswelo ne mu Babele mwine. Bantu ba mu Ulu ne mu Babele kebādipo pamo bwa Noa ne wandi mwana Shema, bāendelele na kwingidila Yehova.

Ku mfulo, myaka 350 kupwa kwa dilobe, Noa muntu wa kikōkeji wāfwa. Pāpityile myaka ibidi, uno muntu omwene pa kino kifwatulo nandi wābutulwa. Wādi umonwa na Leza bu muntu mwishile na bakwabo, umusangaja. Wādi utelwa dya bu Abalahama. Wādi ushikete na kisaka kyandi mu kino kibundi kya Ulu.

Difuku dimo Yehova wāsapwila Abalahama’mba: ‘Funduka mu Ulu ne mu babutule bobe, wende ku ntanda yonkakulombola.’ Lelo Abalahama wākōkele Leza ne kushiya byabupeta byonso byeñenya bya ntanda ya Ulu? Eyo, wākōkele. Kadi wāyukene bu Mulunda na Leza mwanda wādi ukōkele Leza nyeke.

Pāfundukile Abalahama mu Ulu, bamobamo ba mu kyandi kisaka bāendele nandi pamo. Shandi Tela nandi wāendele nandi. Ne Lota mwanā mwanabo nandi monka. Sala mukaja Abalahama nandi kāshelepo, wāenda nabo. Lwendo lwādi lulampe, ponka’po bāfika mu kibundi kitelwa bu Halane, mwāfwidile Tela. Kibundi kya Ulu kyādi ke kishale kulampe.

Mafuku pa kupita’po, Abalahama ne kisaka kyandi bākuta lwendo kutamba mu Halane ne kwenda mu ntanda itelwa bu Kenani. Kwine’kwa, Yehova kanena’mba: ‘Nkapānanga ntanda ino’i ku bobe bana.’ Abalahama wāshikata mu Kenani ne kulāla mu mapema.

Leza wāshilula kukwasha Abalahama, ebiya wāikala na luombe lukatampe lwa mikōko ne banyema bakwabo ne bengidi tutwa na tutwa. Inoko aye ne wandi mukaji Sala kebādipo na bana.

Abalahama pādi na myaka 99, Yehova wāmunena’mba: ‘Nakulaya’mba ukekalanga shandya mizo mivule ya bantu.’ Ino lelo uno mwanda wādi wa kulongeka muswelo’ka, byādi ba Abalahama ne Sala ke banunu bininge, kebakidipo na muswelo wa kubutula?Ngalwilo 11:27-32; 12:1-7; 17:1-8, 15-17; 18:9-19. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

LELO umwene bilonga Abalahama pano? Ukwete lupete, ne bimweka bu usakanga kwipaya wandi mwana. Mwanda waka usaka kumwipaya? Dibajinji bidi, tubandaulei muswelo wābutwile Abalahama ne Sala uno wabo mwana.

Vuluka, Leza wēbalaile’mba bakabutula mwana. Inoko kyāmwekele bu kekikokejikapo, ke-bantu ba Abalahama ne Sala bādi ke banunu bininge. Inoko, Abalahama wāitabije amba Leza ukokeja kulonga kyokya kimweka bu kekikokejikapo. Lelo i kika kyālongekele?

Mwaka mutuntulu wāpityile’po tamba pālaile Leza uno mulao. Kupwa, kitatyi kyābwenye Abalahama myaka 100, Sala nandi myaka 90, bābutula mwana mwana-mulume, bāmwinika dya bu Isake. Leza wāfikidije mulao wandi!

Ino pātamine Isake, Yehova wātompele lwitabijo lwa Abalahama. Wāmwita’mba: ‘Abalahama!’ Abalahama nandi wālondolola’mba: ‘Vidye Kalombo.’ Kupwa Leza wānena’mba: ‘Sela obe mwana, mwana obe umo kete, Isake, enda ku lūlu lonkakulombola. Shi ubafika’ko, ipaya obe mwana ne kumwela konka ke kya mulambu kisōkwe.’

Bine Abalahama wākwetwe bulanda bukatampe pa kwivwana bino binenwa, ke-muntu wādi usenswe wandi mwana bininge. Kadi vuluka, Leza wālaile’mba bana ba Abalahama bādi ba kukekala mu ntanda ya Kenani. Inoko byādi bya kwikala namani shi Isake wāfwile? Abalahama kāivwanijepo kino, inoko wakōkela Leza.

Kitatyi kyaāfikile ku lūlu, Abalahama wākuta Isake myonji ne kumutūla pa madabahu awāshimikile. Kupwa wākwata kipete amba epaye wandi mwana. Ponka’po, mwikeulu wa Leza wāmwela lubila’mba: ‘Abalahama, Abalahama!’ Abalahama nandi wāitaba’mba: ‘Vidye Kalombo!’

Leza wānena’mba: ‘Kokatapa mwanuke nansha kumulonga kintu kampanda. Pano nayuka’mba wakaminwe Leza byokumpelejepo mwana obe, mwana obe umo kete.’

Bine Abalahama wādi na lwitabijo lukomo mudi Leza! Wādi ukulupile’mba i kutupu kintu kikomēne Yehova kulonga, ne amba ukokeja nansha kusangula Isake mu bafwe. Inoko Leza kādipo usaka Abalahama epaye Isake. Penepo Leza wātonona mukōko amba upatame mu kivunda kyādi pabwipi, kadi wāsapwila Abalahama eulambule bu kya mulambu kisokwe kya kupingakena pa wandi mwana.Ngalwilo 21:1-7; 22:1-18. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

LOTA ne kisaka kyandi bādi bashikete pamo na Abalahama mu ntanda ya Kenani. Difuku dimo Abalahama wāsapwila Lota’mba: ‘Pano ntanda keikitubwenepo kushikata na banyema betu bonso. Nakwisāshila, twisansanye abe ne ami. Shi wenda ku lunkuso nankyo ku lundyo ko kwami, shi wenda ku lundyo nankyo ku lunkuso ko kwami.’

Lota wātulula meso katale ntanda. Wāmona kipindi kimo kya ntanda kiyampe’tu kyādi na mema ne biyombo bingi bya dyangi bya banyema bandi. Ino yādi ntanda ya Yodano. Lota wāvilukila’ko aye ne kisaka kyandi ne banyema bandi. Bāfika ne kushikata bāshikata mu kibundi kya Sodoma.

Bantu ba mu Sodoma bādi babi bininge. Uno mwanda wāfityije Lota mutyima, mwanda wādi muntu muyampe. Leza nandi wāfityilwe. Kupwa, Leza wātuma bamwikeulu babidi bakadyumune Lota’mba Leza usa konakanya Sodoma ne Ngomola kibundi kya pabwipi, mwanda i bibundi bibi.

Bamwikeulu bāsapwila Lota’mba: ‘Longa bukidi, sela obe mukaji ne bana bobe babidi bana-bakaji, mutaluke muno!’ Lota ne kisaka kyandi bādi baleñanya, ponka’po bamwikeulu bēbakwata ku makasa ne kwibalupwila panja pa kibundi. Penepo mwikeulu umo wānena’mba: ‘Mwipandijei būmi, kemukitala kunyuma nansha kwimana mu dilungu, nyemenai ku lūlu, kutyina’mba mwakalotejibwa.’ Lota ne bandi bana bana-bakaji bākōkele, bānyemena kulampe na Sodoma. Kēbaimenepo nansha kutala kunyuma kwine. Inoko mukaja Lota kākōkelepo. Pa kupwa kwenda kyaba kampanda kutamba ku Sodoma, mukaja Lota wāimene, wātala kunyuma. Ponka’po wāalamuka ke kyulu kya mwepo. Lelo umumwene pa kino kifwatulo?

Tukokeja kuboila’po bufundiji bulumbuluke. Kitulombola’mba Leza upandijanga boba bamukōkele, inoko boba bakubulwa kumukōkela bakajimija būmi bwabo.Ngalwilo 13:5-13; 18:20-33; 19:1-29; Luka 17:28-32; 2 Petelo 2:6-8. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

LELO uyukile uno mwana-mukaji udi pa kino kifwatulo? Dijina dyandi i Lebeka. Ne mwana-mulume obakesambakana nandi i Isake. Usa kwikala mukajandi. Byāikele muswelo’ka?

Byāikele namino, Abalahama, shandya Isake, wādi usaka kumusongela mukaji muyampe. Kādipo usaka Isake asonge mukaji Mwine Kenani, mwanda bano bantu bādi batōta baleza ba bubela. Enka nenki Abalahama wāita umpika wandi, kāmunena’mba: ‘Enda ku Halana, ntanda ya babutule bami, ukasongele wami mwana Isake mukaji.’

Ponka’po, umpika wa Abalahama wāyata bangamedia dikumi ne kukuta lwendo kaenda, lwādi lwendo lulampe. Wāfika kubwipi na kushikatanga babutule ba Abalahama, wāimana pa mushimwa wa mema. Kwādi ke ku kyolwa, pa kitatyi pailanga bana-bakaji ba mu kibundi kuteka mema ku mushimwa. Penepo umpika wa Abalahama wālombela kudi Leza amba: ‘Mwana-mukaji ukateka mema ne kumpa ami ne bangamedia, nankyo ye aye owatonga kwikala mukaja Isake.’

Pano ne pano Lebeka waiya kuteka mema. Uno umpika wāmulomba mema a kutoma, Lebeka wāmupa. Kupwa wāenda kukateka mema mavule a bangamedia bādi na kyumwa. Uno wādi mwingilo mukomo, mwanda bangamedia batomanga mema mavule.

Lebeka pa kupwa kwingila uno mwingilo, umpika wa Abalahama wāmwipangula dijina dya shandi. Kadi wāmulomba shi ukokeja kulāla kwabo bobwa bufuku. Wālondolola’mba: ‘Tata i Betule, kadi kwetu kudi kyaba kya abe kwikala pamo netu.’ Umpika wa Abalahama wādi uyukile’mba Betule i mwanā Nahola, mwanabo na Abalahama. Ebiya, wāfukama manwi panshi ne kufwija’ko Yehova pa mwanda wa kumuludika kwaāmuludikile kudi banababo na Abalahama.

Bwine bufuku’bwa, umpika wa Abalahama wāsapwila Betule ne Lebane, tutu wa Lebeka, mwanda wāidile. Abo bonso babidi bāitabija’mba Lebeka ende nandi, akasongwe na Isake. Lebeka wālondolwele namani kitatyi kyobamwipangwile? Wāitabije kwenda, wānena’mba ‘Eyo.’ Ponka’po, difuku dilonda’po, bakanda pa bangamedia ne kukuta lwendo, kebajokela ku Kenani.

Bāfikile ke ku kyolwa. Lebeka wāmona mwana-mulume wādi wenda unanga mu budimi. Wādi Isake. Isake wāsangele pa kumona Lebeka. Inandi Sala wādi ke mufwe ke papite ne myaka isatu, ino aye wādi enka na bulanda. Inoko pano Isake pa kumona Lebeka, wāmusanswa bininge, wāikala monka na nsangaji.Ngalwilo 24:1-67. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

BANO banuke bana-balume babidi i beshile bininge, mwene i amo? Lelo uyukile majina abo? Uno kiluwe omwene i Esau, uno mwanuke mukwabo ulama mikōko i Yakoba.

Esau ne Yakoba bādi bana ba mapasa ba Isake ne Lebeka. Shabo, Isake wādi usenswe Esau bininge, mwanda wādi kiluwe wa binebine ne kadi wādi usokwela kisaka kyabo bidibwa. Inoko Lebeka aye wādi usenswe Yakoba, mwanda wādi utalala, mwana usenswe ndoe.



Pano, nkambo wabo Abalahama wādi ukidi mūmi, kadi fwatakanya muswelo wādi usenswe Yakoba kuteja nsekununi ya Yehova kudi Abalahama. Mafuku pa kupita’po Abalahama wāfwa na myaka 175, papo bano bana ba mapasa bādi kebadi na myaka 15.

Pābwenye Esau myaka 40, wāsongele bakaji babidi ba mu ntanda ya Kenani. Ba Isake ne Lebeka bāfityilwe bininge pa uno mwanda, ke-bantu bano bana-bakaji kebādipo batōta Yehova.

Kupwa, difuku dimo kwalupuka mwanda wālengeje Esau akalabele mwanabo Yakoba bininge. Wālongekele kitatyi kyādi kisaka Isake kwesela wandi mwana mukulu. Esau wādi utengele kutambula dino dyese mwanda wādi mukudile Yakoba. Inoko Esau wādi kala ke mupoteje lupusa lwa kutambula dyese kudi Yakoba. Kadi, kitatyi kyābutwilwe bano bana babidi, Leza wānene’mba Yakoba ye aye ukatambula dyese. Ne kyālongekele enka nankyo. Isake wāesela Yakoba wandi mwana.

Kunyuma, Esau pa kuyuka uno mwanda, wākalabela Yakoba bininge. Wākalabele bininge wāfika ne ku kunena’mba usa kwipaya Yakoba. Lebeka pa kwivwana nankyo, wāfitwa bininge. Enka nankyo, wāsapwila wandi mulume Isake amba: ‘I kibi bininge shi Yakoba nandi asonge mukaji Mwine Kenani.’

Kupwa Isake wāita Yakoba wandi mwana, kāmusapwila’mba: ‘Kokasonga mukaji wa mu Kenani. Enda ku njibo ya nkambo obe Betule mu Halana. Songa umo wa mu bana bana-bakaji ba wandi mwana Lebane.’

Yakoba wāivwana madingi a shandi, enka penepa, wākuta lwendo lwandi lulampe kaenda ku babutule babo mu Halana.Ngalwilo 25:5-11, 20-34; 26:34, 35; 27:1-46; 28:1-5; Bahebelu 12:16, 17. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

LELO uyukile bano bana-balume besamba na Yakoba? Pa kupwa kwenda lwendo umbula mwa mafuku mavule, Yakoba wēbatene pa mushimwa. Bādi balama mikōko yabo. Penepo Yakoba wāipangula’mba: ‘Mutamba kwepi?’

Abo nabo balondolola’mba: ‘Ku Halana.’

Yakoba wēbepangula’mba: ‘Lelo muyukile Lebane?’

Nabo bāmutentulula’mba: ‘Eyo. Kadi mona’po bidi, Letyela wandi mwana mwana-mukaji yewa wiya ne luombe lwa mikōko yandi.’ Lelo umwene Letyela wiya kokwa kulampe? Yakoba pa kumona Letyela na mikōko ya Lebane manseba wandi, wāenda kukakuvumuna dibwe ku mushimwa mwanda wa mikōko itome mema. Yakoba wāfifya Letyela kadi wētēla. Letyela wāsangala bikatampe, wāenda ku njibo kukasapwila shandi Lebane.

Lebane wāsangele bikatampe, wāitabija Yakoba ekale nandi. Ne pālombele Yakoba kusonga Letyela, Lebane wāsepelele. Inoko wālomba Yakoba engile mu budimi bwandi mu bula bwa myaka isamba-ibidi, nabya apebwe Letyela. Yakoba wāingila mwanda wādi usenswe Letyela bininge. Inoko kitatyi kya butundaile pokyābwene, lelo uyukile byālongekele?

Lebane wāmupele Lea, wandi mwana mwana-mukaji mukulumpe, pa kyaba kya Letyela. Pāitabije Yakoba kwingidila monka Lebane mu bula bwa myaka isamba-ibidi mikwabo, Lebane wāmupa kadi Letyela ke mukajandi. Mu kine kitatyi’kya, Leza wālekele bana-balume bekale na bakaji bavule. Inoko pano, pamo’nka na mwikilombwela Bible, mwana-mulume ufwaninwe kwikala enka na mukaji umo.Ngalwilo 29:1-30. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

TALA bidi kino kisaka kikatampe. Bano i bana bana-balume 12 ba Yakoba. Kadi udi na bana bana-bakaji. Lelo uyukile majina a bano bana? Twifundei majina abo.

Lea wābutwile Lubeni, Shimioni, Levi ne Yuda. Letyela wāfityilwe bikatampe mwanda kādipo ubutula. Ponka’po, wāpa Yakoba mwingidi wandi Bidiha, nandi wābutula bana bana-balume babidi betwa bu Dani ne Nafatale. Kupwa Lea nandi wāpa Yakoba mwingidi wandi Zidipa, Zidipa wābutula Ngade ne Ashela. Kupwa Lea wābutula bana bakwabo babidi, Isakala ne Zebuluna.

Kupwa Letyela nandi wābutula mwana. Wāmwita dya bu Yosefa. Kumeso tukefunda bivule bitala Yosefa, mwanda wāikele ke muntu mukatampe mpata. Bano bo bana 11 ba Yakoba bābutwile paādi ushikete na Lebane, shandya Letyela.

Yakoba wādi kadi ne na bana bana-bakaji, inoko Bible utelele enka dijina dya umo, Dina.

Kitatyi kyābwene kya Yakoba kushiya Lebane ne kujokela ku Kenani. Ponka’po, wābungila kyandi kisaka kikatampe pamo ne luombe lwandi lukatampe lwa mikōko ne bañombe, kaenda lwendo lulampe.

Yakoba ne kisaka kyandi pa kujokela mu Kenani mafuku matyetye, Letyela wābutula mwana mukwabo. Wābutwile pobādi bakidi mu lwendo. Letyela wāsusukile bininge, ebiya wāfwa pa kupwa kubutula. Inoko mwana mwana-mulume waābutwile wāpanda. Yakoba wāmwinika dya bu Benjemani.

Tufwaninwe kuvuluka majina a bana 12 ba Yakoba mwanda muzo onso wa Isalela i mutambe kobadi. Misuku 12 ya Isalela itelwanga pa majina a bana ba Yakoba 10 ne bana babidi ba Yosefa. Isake wāikele myaka mivule pa kupwa kubutulwa kwa bano bana bana-balume bonso, bine, wāloelelwe bikatampe pa kwikala na bankana bavule. Inoko, tutalei bidi kyāfikile wandi munkana nsongwakaji Dina.Ngalwilo 29:32-35; 30:1-26; 35:16-19; 37:35. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

UMWENE bano bakanangila Dina? Ukanangilanga bansongwakaji ba mu ntanda ya Kenani. Lelo shandi Yakoba ukasangela uno mwanda? Pa kulondolola kino kipangujo, tompa kuvuluka milangwe ya Abalahama ne Isake pa bana bana-bakaji ba mu Kenani. Lelo Abalahama wāsakile wandi mwana Isake āsonge mwana-mukaji Mwine Kenani? Mhm, kāsakilepo. Lelo Isake ne Lebeka bāsenswe wabo mwana Yakoba kusonga nsongwakaji Mwine Kenani? Mhm, bāpelele. Le uyukile mwanda waka?

Mwanda bano Bene Kenani bādi batōta baleza ba bubela. Kebādipo bantu bayampe kwikala nabo bu balume nansha bu bakaji, nansha bu balunda ba pa mutyima. Nanshi tukokeja kwitabija’mba Yakoba kāloelelwepo wandi mwana mwana-mukaji kusamba bulunda na bano bansongwakaji Bene Kenani.

Bine, Dina wātenwe na makambakano. Lelo umwene uno mwana-mulume Mwine Kenani utala Dina pa kino kifwatulo? Dijina dyandi i Shekema. Difuku dimo Dina wāile kunanga, penepa Shekema wāmukwata ne kulāla nandi ku bukomo. Buno bwādi bubi, mwanda enka bana-balume ne bana-bakaji bēsonge bo bafwaninwe kulāla pamo. Buno bubi bwāmulongeje Shekema, bwāletēle Dina makambakano makatampe.

Banababo na Dina pa kwivwana uno mwanda, bākwatwa bulobo bininge. Shimioni ne Levi byobākwetwe bulobo bukatampe, bāyata bipete, bāenda mu kibundi, bākatamba bana-balume divita mu kitulumukila. Abo ne banababo bāipaya Shekema ne bana-balume bakwabo bonso. Yakoba wāloba pa mwanda wa kino kilongwa kibi kyālongele bandi bana.

Ino lelo ano makambakano onso āshilwile muswelo’ka? I pa mwanda Dina wāsambile bulunda na bantu bakubulwa kukōkela ku bijila bya Leza. Ketufwaninwepo kusamba bulunda na bantu ba uno muswelo, mwene i amo?Ngalwilo 34:1-31. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

TALA’PO uno nkasampe, udi bya lusa ne bya bulanda. I Yosefa. Banababo abamupoteja ku bano bana-balume benda ku Edipito. Yosefa wākekala’ko bu umpika. Mwanda waka banababo bālongele kintu kibi uno muswelo? Mwanda bākwatyīlwe Yosefa mukao.

Shabo Yakoba wādi usenswe Yosefa bininge. Wālombwele buswe bwandi na kumupa mutwelo muyampe mulampe. Batutu wandi 10 pa kumona Yakoba mwasanshilwe Yosefa, bāshilula kumushikwa ne kumukwatyilwa mukao. Ino kwādi ne bubinga bukwabo bobādi bamushikilwe.

Yosefa wālotele bilotwa bibidi. Mu bino bilotwa byandi byonso bibidi, wāmwene banababo bamufukatyila. Yosefa pa kulombola banababo bino bilotwa, nabo po pene bāmushikwa kupita.

Ebiya difuku dimo, batutu wa Yosefa bākakumbile mikōko ya Shabo, Yakoba wātuma Yosefa ende akebatale mobekadile. Banababo pa kumumona wiya, bamo kebanena’mba: ‘Tumwipayei.’ Ino Lubeni tutu wabo mukulu, wānena’mba: ‘Mhm, kemukilongai nankyo!’ Penepa bākwata Yosefa ne kumwela mu kina mwakubulwa mema. Bāshikata kebakimbe kya kumulonga i kika. Ponka’po, Bene Ishemele bana bana-balume baiya. Yuda wānena banababo’mba: ‘Tumupotejei ku Bene Ishemele.’ Bālongela monka. Bāpoteja Yosefa ku bityele 20 bya ndalama. Yō, bine kebādipo na lusa!

Lelo banababo bākalombwele shabo kika? Ponka’po bātapa mbuji ne kutubika misunsa mivule mutwelo mulumbuluke wa Yosefa mu mashi a mbuji’wa. Bātuma mutwelo kudi shabo Yakoba amba: ‘Tubatana kino’ki. Jingulula umone shi ke mutwelopo wa Yosefa.’

Yakoba wēutala’mba i ao. Wādila’mba: ‘Yō, padi i nyema wa budyani wābokwete Yosefa.’ Ne ye akyo kyādi kisaka banababo na Yosefa kukulupija shabo. Yakoba wāfitwa mutyima bininge. Wāmudila mafuku mavule. Ino Yosefa kāfwilepo. Tutalei byāmufikile kokwa kwaāselelwe.Ngalwilo 37:1-35. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

YOSEFA wādi na myaka 17 paāselelwe ku Edipito. Potifela wāmupota. Potifela wādi wingila kwa mulopwe wa Edipito, witwa bu Felo.

Yosefa wādi wingidila mfumwandi Potifela bininge. Ebiya Yosefa pa kutama, Potifela wāmupa buledi bwa njibo yandi yonso. Mwanda waka kadi Yosefa udi muno mu kifungo? I pa mwanda wa mukaja Potifela.

Yosefa wādi mwana-mulume wa mpala miyampe, papo mukaja Potifela kāabila kulāla nandi. Ino Yosefa wāyukile’mba i kibi, wāpela kulāla nandi. Mukaja Potifela wāloba bininge. Ebiya wandi mulume pa kujoka ku njibo, wāmubepela’mba: ‘Uno Yosefa i muntu mubi, wadi wansake amba alāle nami.’ Potifela wāitabija binenwa bya mukajandi ne kukalabela Yosefa byamwiko’tu. Penepa wāmweleja mu kifungo.

Kepejije kalama wa kifungo wāmona’mba Yosefa i muntu muyampe. Penepa wāmupa kutala babuloko bonso. Kupwa papo Felo wālobela bandi ba kaseya ne mutēki, wēbela mu kifungo. Bufuku bumo, bālota bilotwa bishile na bikwabo, ino kebāyukilepo nshintulwilo yabyo. Ke kesha, Yosefa wānena’mba: ‘Nsapwilei bilotwa byenu.’ Abo pa kumusapwila, Yosefa wēbalombola nshintulwilo yabyo na bukwashi bwa Leza.

Yosefa wānena kaseya’mba: ‘Mu mafuku asatu ukalupulwa mu kifungo, kadi ukekala monka kaseya wa Felo.’ Penepa Yosefa wābweja’ko amba: ‘Pokatamba muno, untela kudi Felo, andupule muno’mu.’ Ino Yosefa wānena mutēki amba: ‘Mu mafuku asatu Felo ukakutyiba mutwe.’

Mu mafuku asatu, byonso byāfikidila monka mwānenene Yosefa. Felo wātyibija mutwe wa mutēki. Ino kaseya aye wālupulwa mu kifungo ne kushilula kwingidila monka mulopwe. Ino kaseya wāilwa Yosefa! Kālombwelepo Felo, penepo Yosefa wāshala mu kifungo.Ngalwilo 39:1-23; 40:1-23. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

MYAKA ibidi ibapite’po, Yosefa ukidi enka mu kifungo. Kaseya kamuvulukilepo. Kupwa bufuku bumo, Felo wālota bilotwa bibidi bishile na bikwabo byonso, ino kāyukilepo nshintulwilo yabyo. Lelo ubamumone pano palēle? Bukya lubanga, Felo wāita bañanga bonso ne kwibalombola bintu byonso byaalota. Ino bākomenwa kumulombola nshintulwilo ya bilotwa byandi.

Ke ku mfulo kaseya wāvuluka Yosefa. Kānena Felo’mba: ‘Ponadi mu kifungo, mwadi muntu wabwenye kushintulula bilotwa.’ Ponka’po Felo wātumanya kukalupula Yosefa mu kifungo. Felo wālombola Yosefa bilotwa byandi amba: ‘Namwene bañombe bakaji basamba-babidi banune, bayampe’tu. Kupwa namona bañombe bakaji basamba-babidi, banyane tēe. Kadi banyane’ba badya boba banune.

‘Mu kilotwa kya bubidi nāmwene mivungu miyampe isamba-ibidi, mitante, ipakata ku mutyi umo. Kupwa namona mivungu isamba-ibidi mifumbe, mitune. Kadi yoya mifumbe yamina yoya miyampe.’ Yosefa wānena Felo amba: ‘Bilotwa byonso bibidi bishintulula kintu kimo. Bañombe bakaji basamba-babidi banune ne mivungu isamba-ibidi mitante i myaka isamba-ibidi, kadi bañombe basamba-babidi banyane ne mivungu isamba-ibidi mifumbe nayo monka i myaka isamba-ibidi. Kukekala myaka isamba-ibidi ya bidibwa bingi mu Edipito. Kupwa kukekala myaka isamba-ibidi ya bidibwa bityetye.’

Penepo Yosefa wālombola Felo’mba: ‘Tonga muntu wa ñeni emanine kungwija bidibwa mu myaka isamba-ibidi ya ndoe. Nankyo bantu kebakafupo nzala mu myaka isamba-ibidi ya nzala ikalonda’ko.’

Felo wānengelelwa uno mulangwe. Wātonga Yosefa abunge bidibwa ne kwibibika mu bibīko. Yosefa wāikala muntu mukatampe kupwa’tu Felo mu Edipito.

Myaka mwanda pa kupita’po, kitatyi kya kipupo kya nzala, Yosefa wāmona bantu bāya. Lelo wibayukile? Mwiko, i batutu wandi dikumi’ba! Shabo Yakoba webatume ku Edipito mwanda kebakidipo na bidibwa mwabo mu Kenani. Yosefa wāyuka banababo, ino abo kumuyuka’po mpika. Uyukile mwanda waka? Mwanda Yosefa ke mukulu, kavwele bisandi bya muswelo mukwabo.

Yosefa wavuluka’mba paādi ukidi mwanuke, wālotele banababo bāya bamufukatyila. Ubavuluka powatangile uno mwanda? Yosefa wayuka’mba i Leza wamutumine muno mu Edipito na bubinga buyampe. Molangila Yosefa usa kulonga kika pano? Leka bidi tutale.Ngalwilo 41:1-57; 42:1-8; 50:20. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

YOSEFA usaka kuyuka shi batutu wandi 10 bakidi babi ne bampikwa lusa. Webanena’mba: ‘Mwi batubedibedi. Mubaiya kutala buzoze bwa yetu ntanda.’

Nabo amba: ‘Mhm, ke amopo. Twi bantu ba binebine. Twi bana na bana batwe bonso. Twadi 12. Inoko umo ke kutupu’ye, mukala nandi ushele na tata kwetu.’

Yosefa walonga bu wibapatanya. Wakute mwanabo witwa bu Shimioni mu kifungo, ne kuleka bakwabo basele bidibwa bende kwabo. Ino webanena’mba: ‘Pa kukajoka, mufwaninwe kupaika ne mukala wenu.’

Abo pa kujokela kwabo ku Kenani, abalombola shabo Yakoba byonso byebafikile. Yakoba wafītwa. Kadila’mba: ‘Yosefa kakidi’kopo, ne Shimioni pano nandi kutupu’ye. Nkisapo kwimupa mukala wami Benjemani.’ Ino bidibwa pa kushilula kutyepa, Yakoba waleka basele Benjemani, bende ku Edipito bakapote bidibwa bikwabo.

Papo Yosefa wamone banababo bāya. Wasepelela bininge pa kumona nkasandi Benjemani. Kufika ne pano, i kutupu ujingulwile’mba mulēme’u i Yosefa. Ebiya Yosefa walonga kintu kimo kya kutompa banababo 10.

Wasoñanya bengidi bandi bayuje bidibwa mu mifuko. Ino pakubulwa kwibayukija, waomekeja kitomeno kyandi kya ndalama mu mufuko wa Benjemani. Abo pa kutaluka ne kwenda kulampe mpika, Yosefa watume bengidi bandi bakebalonde. Bengidi pa kwibapeta, kebebanena’mba: ‘Mwanda waka mubaibe kitomeno kya ndalama kya mfumwetu?’

Bonso balondolola’mba: ‘Ketwibilepo kitomeno kyandi. Shi mubatana kitomeno na yense wa umbukata mwetu, nankyo yao muntu afwe.’

Penepa bengidi ababandaula mu mifuko yonso, abatana kitomeno mu mufuko wa Benjemani, enka na mowekimwena pano’mu. Bengidi abanena’mba: ‘Banwe bakwabo endai, inoko Benjemani ufwaninwe kwaluka netu.’ Lelo banababo 10 pano abalonga kika?

Bonso abajoka pamo na Benjemani ku njibo ya Yosefa. Yosefa wanena banababo’mba: ‘Banwe endai kwenu, ino Benjemani ukashala kuno ke umpika wami.’

Yuda watentulula’mba: ‘Shi njoke pampikwa uno mwanuke, tata wami ukafwa mwanda umusenswe bininge. Nakwisāshila, ngikale umpika obe kuno, ino uno mwanuke umuleke ajoke kwetu.’

Yosefa wamone amba banababo abaalamuka. Kebadi pano na lusa. Tubandaulei pano kyalonga Yosefa.Ngalwilo 42:9-38; 43:1-34; 44:1-34. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

YOSEFA wakomenwa kūmija mutyima kitatyi kilampe. Wanena bengidi bonso batambe mu kyumba. Pa kushala kasuku na banababo, Yosefa washilula kudila. Tukokeja kulanga mwatulumukila banababo, mwanda kebayukilepo kyadidila. Ku mfulo webanena’mba: ‘Ami ne Yosefa. Le tata ukidi mūmi?’

Banababo abatulumuka bininge ne kya kunena kibebabulwe. Abakwatwa moyo. Ino Yosefa wanena’mba: ‘Fwenai kondi.’ Abo pa kumufwena, webanena’mba: ‘Ne mwanenu Yosefa, omwāpoteje mu Edipito.’

Yosefa lusa lubamukwata, kanena’mba: ‘Kemukītopekai pa mwanda omwāumpoteje kuno. Leza ye wāntumine kuno ku Edipito mpandije būmi bwa bantu. Felo i mumbikike mu ntanda yonso. Pano pejai mwende kudi tata mukamulombole byonso bino’bi. Mulombolei aye ekale kuno.’

Kupwa Yosefa wafumbakanya banababo ne kwibafifya abo bonso. Penepa Felo waivwana’mba banababo na Yosefa i bāye, wanena Yosefa’mba: ‘Wibaleke basele makalo bakapaike shabo ne bisaka byabo, bāye nabo kuno. Nkebapa ntanda milumbuluke mu Edipito.’

Nabo ye mobālongele. Omwene uno i Yosefa utundaila shandi pa kufika mu Edipito ne kisaka kyandi kyonso. Kisaka kya Yakoba ke kikatampe. Pobāvilukile mu Edipito bādi 70, kubadila’mo Yakoba ne bana bandi ne bankana bene kumo. Kadi kwādi ne babo bakaji ne bengidi bavule. Bonso bāile mu Edipito. Bādi bebeta bu Bene Isalela, mwanda Leza wāshintyile dijina dya Yakoba bu Isalela. Bene Isalela bāikele ke muzo wa Leza wa pa bula, ye motukekimwena kumeso kotwenda’ku.Ngalwilo 45:1-28; 46:1-27. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

data.titulo: Yoba Udi na Kikōkeji Kudi Leza
data.contenido:
LELO ubakwatyilwa uno ubēla lusa? Dijina dyandi i Yoba, ne uno lolo’u i wandi mukaji. Uyukile byaanena Yoba? ‘Tuka Leza, ufwe.’ Leka tumone kyaanenena namino, ne kisusukila Yoba i kika.

Yoba wādi muntu ukōkele Yehova. Wādi wikele mu ntanda ya Uza, kubwipi na Kenani. Yehova wādi usenswe Yoba bininge, ino kudi wādi umushikilwe. Lelo umuyukile?

I Satana Dyabola. Vuluka, Satana i mwikeulu mubi ushikilwe Yehova. Wāongwele ba Adama ne Eva bātombokela Yehova, kadi wādi ufwatakanya’mba ukabombolanga bantu bonso nabo baleke kukōkela Yehova. Ino lelo wābwenye? Mhm. Langa bidi bana-balume ne bana-bakaji bavule ba kikōkeji botwefunda mānga yabo. Ukokeja kutela’mo banga’le?

Kupwa kwa lufu lwa Yakoba ne Yosefa mu Edipito, Yoba ye wāikele muntu wa kikōkeji kudi Yehova kupita bonso pano pa ntanda. Yehova wāsakile kuyukija Satana’mba kakokejapo kongola bantu bonso bekale babi, wānena’mba: ‘Tala Yoba. Ubamone muswelo waunkōkele.’

Satana wāpatanya’mba: ‘Ukukōkele mwanda wi mumwesele kadi aye udi na bintu bingi. Ino shi umuyate’byo ukakutuka.’

Yehova wānena’mba: ‘Enda. Kamuyate’byo. Longa Yoba byonso byosaka. Tumone shi ukantuka. Inoko kokamwipaya.’ Dibajinji, Satana wātonona bantu bebe Yoba bangamedia ne bañombe, ne mikōko yandi yāipaibwa. Kupwa wāmwipaila ne bana 10 na kivula kikatampe. Kadi Satana wāmubeleka misongo mikomokomo. Yoba wāsusuka bininge. O mwanda mukaji wāmunene’mba: ‘Tuka Leza, ufwe.’ Ino Yoba kātukilepo Leza. Balunda nandi ba bubela basatu bāiya ke bāmunena’mba udi na būmi butyani. Ino Yoba wālamine kikōkeji kyandi.

Yehova wāsangele mpata, ku mfulo wāesela Yoba, enka na momwena pa kifwatulo pano. Wāpwija misongo yandi. Yoba wābutula bana bakwabo 10 bapopoke, kadi bañombe, bangamedia ne mikōko wāikala nabyo misunsa ibidi kupita dibajinji.

Lelo nobe ukakōkela Yehova nyeke pamo bwa Yoba? Shi i amo, nankyo nobe Leza ukakwesela. Ukekala nyeke pano pa ntanda kitatyi kyopakekala palumbuluke pamo bwa budimi bwa Edena.Yoba 1:1-22; 2:1-13; 42:10-17. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

BANO bana-balume bengidijanga bantu mingilo ku bukomo. Tala yeu muntu ukupila mwingidi umo nsonde! Bengidi bano i ba ku kisaka kya Yakoba, betwa bu Bene Isalela. Ne bantu bebengidija ku bukomo i Bene Edipito. Bene Isalela pano ke bapika ba Bene Edipito. Le byāikele muswelo’ka?

Umbula bwa myaka mivule, kisaka kikatampe kya Yakoba kyāikele mu ndoe mu Edipito. Yosefa, mwine wādi muntu mulēme mu Edipito kupwa Felo, wēbalelele biyampe. Ino kupwa Yosefa wāfwa. Felo mupya, wādi ushikilwe Bene Isalela, wābikala pa Edipito.

Penepo uno Felo umbi wāmuna Bene Isalela bupika. Wābika batulāla pobadi, bantu ba kasusu ne bakalabale. Bāingidija Bene Isalela mingilo mikomo ya kūbaka bibundi bya Felo. Ino Bene Isalela po pene bavula. Kupwa Bene Edipito bākwatwa moyo amba Bene Isalela abavula bibi kadi badi na bukomo. Lelo uyukile kyālongele Felo? Wālombola babimbutuja ba Bene Isalela’mba: ‘Mufwaninwe kwipaya bana bana-balume bonso babutulwa.’ Ino babimbutuja bādi bana-bakaji bayampe, kebāipailepo mwana nansha umo.

Penepo Felo wāsoñanya bantu bandi amba: ‘Ipayai bana balukeke bana-balume ba Bene Isalela. Lekai enka bana bana-bakaji.’ Mwene ino i mbila mibi mpata? Leka tumone mwāpandile mwana umo.Divilu 1:6-22. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

TALA uno mwana wa lukeke udila koku ukwete uno nsongwakaji ku munwe. I Mosesa. Le uyukile uno nsongwakaji mupopoke i ani? I mwanā Felo, mulopwe wa Edipito.

Inandya Mosesa wāfile wandi mwana kufika’nka ne byaābwenye myeji isatu, mwanda kāsakilepo epaibwe na Bene Edipito. Ino wādi uyukile’mba Mosesa ukokeja kusokolwa, penepo wālonga namino mwanda wa kumupandija.

Wāyete kitenge wēkishinga bunange kutyina’mba mema akatwela’mo. Kupwa wābika’mo Mosesa, wākatūla kine kitenge’kya mu mabungu ku lubungo lwa Munonga wa Nile. Kaka wa Mosesa, Midiamu, wānenwe kwimana kubwipi amone kikamufikila. Ponka’po, mwanā Felo mwana-mukaji wāiya koya ku Munonga wa Nile. Amba atale, wāmona kisaku mu mabungu. Wāita mwingidi wandi umo mwana-mukaji kāmunena’mba: ‘Ndetele kisaku’kya.’ Mwanā mulopwe pa kupūtula’mo, wāmona mwana muyampe! I Mosesa wādi udila, penepa mwanā mulopwe wāmukwatyilwa lusa. Kāsakilepo bamwipaye.

Kupwa Midiamu wāiya. Ukokeja kumumona pa kifwatulo. Midiamu wāipangula mwanā Felo amba: ‘Lelo ñende nkete mwana-mukaji Mwine Isalela wa kukwamushisha uno mwana?’

Nandi wāmulondolola’mba: ‘Enda.’

Penepa Midiamu wānyema lubilo kuketa inandi. Inandya Mosesa pa kufika, mwanā mulopwe wāmunena’mba: ‘Sela mwana ukañamushishe’ye, nami nkakufuta.’

Penepa inandya Mosesa wākalela wandi mwana wa aye mwine. Kupwa Mosesa wātama, inandi wākamutūla kwa mwanā Felo wāmuyete bu wandi mwana. Uno ye muswelo wātamīne Mosesa mu njibo ya Felo.Divilu 2:1-10. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

TALA Mosesa unyema mu Edipito. Lelo ubamone bana-balume bamulonda’ba? Uyukile mwanda obakimba kwipaila Mosesa? Leka tumone shi tukokeja kuyuka.

Mosesa wātamīne mu njibo ya Felo, mulopwe wa Edipito. Wāikala ke muntu mukatampe ne wa tunangu. Mosesa wāyukile’mba aye kādipo Mwine Edipito, ino bambutwile bandi ba bine i bapika Bene Isalela.

Difuku dimo, Mosesa paādi kadi na myaka 40, wāendele kukatala mwikadile banababo. Bādi basusulwa bya mwiko. Wāmona Mwine Edipito ukupila umpika Mwine Isalela. Mosesa wātala koku ne koku, kutupu muntu, penepa wākupila Mwine Edipito, ne kufwa wafwa. Kupwa Mosesa wāmufya mu musenga.

Difuku dikwabo Mosesa wātamba kutala monka banababo. Wādi ulanga amba ukokeja kwibakwasha baleke kwikala bapika monka. Ino wāmona Bene Isalela babidi bana-balume bekupila, penepa Mosesa wānena wādi mulube amba: ‘I kika kyokupidila mwanenu?’

Mwana-mulume wānena’mba: ‘I ani wakutūla bu mfumu ne bu mutyibi wetu? Lelo kosake ungipaye mowaipaile Mwine Edipito?’

Mosesa wākwatwa moyo. Wāyuka’mba bantu abajingulula byonalongele Mwine Edipito. Felo nandi wāivwana’o, wātuma bantu bakepaye Mosesa. Kino ye akyo kyānyemene Mosesa mu Edipito.

Mosesa pa kutaluka mu Edipito, wāendele kulampe ku ntanda ya Midyana. Wēkutana kisaka kya Yefelo, wāsonga wandi mwana mwana-mukaji witwa bu Zipola. Mosesa wāikala ke mukumbi wa mikōko ya Yefelo. Wāshikata ku Midyana myaka 40. Pano wādi kadi na myaka 80. Difuku dimo, Mosesa wādi ukumba mikōko ya Yefelo, penepo kwāmumwekela kintu kimo kyāalamwine būmi bwandi bonso. Pūtula dino dyani, utale kino kintu kya kutulumukwa.Divilu 2:11-25; Bilongwa 7:22-29. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

MOSESA waēndele kufika’nka ne ku lūlu lwa Holeba kukakimba biyombo bya kudisha mikōko yandi. Wēkumona kimuna kitēma mudilo, ino kulota’kyo mpika!

Mosesa wālanga’mba: ‘Kino i kimonwa. Leka bidi mfwene njingulule.’ Aye pa kufwena, diwi dyātamba mu bukata bwa kimuna’mba: ‘Kokafwena. Vūla bikwabilo byobe, mwanda poimene’po i pajila.’ I Leza wādi unena kupityila mudi mwikeulu, o mwanda Mosesa wēfile mpala yandi.

Kupwa Leza wāmunena’mba: ‘Namone masusu a bantu bami mu Edipito. Nanshi nkebakūla, kadi nakutume abe ukalupule bantu bami mu Edipito.’ Yehova wādi usaka kukatwala bantu bandi mu ntanda miyampe ya Kenani.

Ino Mosesa wānena’mba: ‘Ami ne wa bitupu. Mbwanya kwibakūla namani? Ino langa bidi shi naenda. Bene Isalela bakangipangula’mba “Le i ani wakutuma?” Lelo nkanena kika?’

Leza nandi amba: ‘Tala kyokanena: “YEHOVA Leza wa Abalahama, Leza wa Isake, ne Leza wa Yakoba wantume komudi.”’ Wābweja’ko amba: ‘Dino ye dyami dijina nyeke ne nyeke.’

Mosesa wālondolola’mba: ‘Ino shi kebankulupilepo ponkanena’mba i abe wantuma.’

Leza wāmwipangula’mba: ‘I kika kidi mu kobe kuboko?’

Mosesa’mba: ‘I mukombo.’

Leza wāmunena’mba: ‘Ela’o panshi.’ Mosesa wēwela, ponka’po mukombo wāikala ke nyoka. Kupwa Yehova wāmulombola kingelengele kikwabo. Wānena’mba: ‘Kuja kuboko mu mbwija yobe.’ Mosesa wēkukuja, aye pakulupula’ko, ke kudi tō! Kuboko kwāikala bwa kukwatwe na misongo mibi itwa bu makopo. Kupwa Yehova wāpa Mosesa bukomo bwa kulonga kingelengele kya busatu. Ku mfulo, wāmunena’mba: ‘Pokalonga bino bingelengele, Bene Isalela bakakulupila’mba i ami wakutuma.’

Penepo Mosesa wājokela ku njibo kanena Yefelo amba: ‘Nakwisāshila, ndeke ñende ku Edipito nkamone mwikadile bantu bami.’ Yefelo wāshindikila Mosesa, Mosesa nandi wāenda ku Edipito.Divilu 3:1-22; 4:1-20. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

PĀJOKĒLE Mosesa mu Edipito, wālombwele mwanabo Alone bingelengele byonso. Ebiya, Mosesa ne Alone bālombola’byo Bene Isalela, bantu bonso bāitabija’mba Yehova wādi nabo.

Kupwa Mosesa ne Alone bāenda kukamona Felo. Bāmunena’mba: ‘Yehova Leza wa Isalela wanena’mba, “Leka bantu bami bende mafuku asatu, bakantōte mu ntanda mutuputupu.”’ Ino Felo wālondolola’mba: ‘Ami nkitabijepo mudi Yehova. Kadi nkikalekapo Isalela ende.’

Felo wākalabala, mwanda bantu bādi ba kuleka mingilo bakatōte Yehova. Penepa wēbengidija mingilo ya kasusu kutabuka. Bene Isalela bātompwela Mosesa pa muswelo umbi waebasuswija, Mosesa nandi wāfitwa mutyima. Ino Yehova wāmunena aleke kukambakanya mutyima. Yehova’mba: ‘Kudi kyonkalonga Felo alekelele bantu bami.’ Mosesa ne Alone bākamona Felo dikwabo. Penepa bālonga kingelengele. Alone wāela mukombo wandi panshi, nao wāalamuka ke nyoka mukata. Bañanga ba Felo nabo bāela mikombo yabo panshi, nayo ke banyoka. Ino, tala! Nyoka wa Alone kamina banyoka ba bañanga. Nansha nankyo, Felo wapele kulekelela bene Isalela bende.

Pano kyaba kya Yehova kya kufundija Felo bufundiji kampanda kibabwana. Uyukile mwasa kumufundijija’bo? Usa kuleta mpupo 10, ko kunena’mba byamalwa bikatampe pa Edipito.

Kupwa kwa bipupo bivule, Felo wādi wityija Mosesa ne kunena’mba: ‘Imika kipupo, nkaleka Isalela ende.’ Ino kipupo pa kwimana, Felo wāshinta milangwe yandi. Wāpela bantu bende. Ino ku mfulo, kupwa kwa kipupo kya 10, Felo wāleka Bene Isalela bende.

Lelo uyukile kimo ne kimo kya mu mpupo 10? Alamuna dyani twibiyuke.Divilu 4:27-31; 5:1-23; 6:1-13, 26-30; 7:1-13. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

TALA bino bifwatulo. Kimo ne kimo kilombolanga kipupo kyāletele Yehova pa Edipito. Pa kifwatulo kibajinji ukokeja kumona Alone ukupila mukombo wandi pa Munonga wa Nile. Penepa mema āalamuka ke mashi. Mwita wa lui onso wāfwa ne munonga wāshilula kununka bibi. Kupwa Yehova wākandija byula kutamba mu Munonga wa Nile. Byāzambalala ponso—mu mafiya, mu bikombola bya mikate, ne pa bitanda bilāla bantu pene—ponso’tu. Byula pa kufwa, Bene Edipito bebibunga milwi ne milwi, kadi byanunka ntanda yonso.

Kupwa Alone wākupila mukombo wandi panshi, luvumbi lwāalamuka ke tumwe. Twishi twa masala tusumana bisansa. Tumwe kyo kyādi kipupo kya busatu pa ntanda ya Edipito. Bipupo byashala byāponēne’nka Bene Edipito kete, kebyāponēnepo Bene Isalela. Kipupo kya buná yādi mpekepeke yāyudile mu mobo a Bene Edipito onso. Kipupo kya butano kyāponēne banyema. Bañombe, mikōko, ne bambuji ba bene Edipito bangi bāfwa.

Kupwa, ba Mosesa ne Alone bāyata buto, bebwela mūlu. Bwālonga bantu tubenga ne banyema bene. Kino i kipupo kya busamba.

Ebiya Mosesa wāolola kuboko mūlu, Yehova nandi wāleta mikungulo ne mvula wa mabwe. Kekwāikelepo mvula mubi namino mu Edipito. Kipupo kya mwanda kyādi kya bibumbo bya njie. Ino njie mingi namino keyāikele’ko kadi keikekala’kopo. Yādile kintu kyonso kekyāonakanibwepo na mvula wa mabwe.

Kipupo kya kitema kyādi kya fukutu. Umbula mwa mafuku asatu fukutu bwī yādi myandabale pa ntanda, inoko mwinya wādi mu bīkalo bya Bene Isalela.

Ku mfulo Leza wānena bantu bandi bashinge mashi a kana ka mbuji nansha kana ka mukōko pa ñunji ya bibelo. Kupwa mwikeulu wa Leza wāpita mu Edipito. Ponso paādi umona mashi, kādipo wipaya muntu mu yayo njibo. Ino mu mobo onso akubulwa mashi pa ñunji ya bibelo, mwikeulu wa Leza wādi wipaya bana babubedi ba bantu ne ba banyema bene. Kino ye kipupo kya 10.

Pa kino kipupo kya mfulo, Felo wānena Bene Isalela bataluke. Bantu ba Leza bonso bādi batengele lwendo, bonka bufuku’bwa bātamba mu Edipito.Divilu shapita 7 ku 12. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa

TALA bipita pano! Uno’u i Mosesa olwedile mukombo wandi pa Kalunga Katyila. Bano bapandile badi nabo uno mutamba i Bene Isalela. Ino Felo ne bibumbo byandi byonso abalobela mu kalunga ka mema. Tutalei mokyāikadile.

Enka na motwefundile, Felo wānene Bene Isalela bafunduke mu Edipito pa kupwa kwa Leza kwibaletela kipupo kya 10. Bana-balume Bene Isalela kubwipi kwa 600 000 bātambile ne bakaji ne bana bavule. Kadi, kibalwa kikatampe kya bantu bakwabo, bāitabije mudi Yehova, bātaluka pamo na Isalela. Nabo bāselele mikōko yabo ne bambuji ne bañombe bene.

Kumeso kwa kutaluka, Bene Isalela bālombele Bene Edipito bebape bisandi ne bintu bya ndalama ne bya nsahabu. Bene Edipito bākwetwe moyo mpata pangala pa kipupo kya mfulo kyēbaponene. O mwanda bāpele Bene Isalela kyonso kyobēbalombele.

Mafuku matyetye, Bene Isalela bāfika ku Kalunga Katyila. Bakōkolokwa konka. Ponka’po, Felo ne bantu bandi bāshilula kutompola kyobapangila Bene Isalela. Kēbanena’mba: ‘Tubaleka’tu betu bapika bende!’

Felo wāalamuna milangwe monka. Bukidi bonka wālongolola makalo andi ne basola. Penepa, wākalonda Bene Isalela na makalo a pa bula 600, kadi ne makalo onso makwabo a Edipito.

Bene Isalela pa kumona Felo ne bibumbo byandi bebalonda, bākwatwa moyo bininge. Kekwādipo kwa kunyemena. Kalunga Katyila kajike kobenda, kunyuma nako Bene Edipito bāya bebalonda. Ino Yehova wābikile dikumbi pa bukata bwa bantu bandi ne Bene Edipito. O mwanda Bene Edipito kebāmwenepo mwa kwibatambila bulwi.

Kupwa Yehova kānena Mosesa olole mukombo wandi pa Kalunga Katyila. Aye pakolola’o, Yehova wātuma luvula lwa kutunduka lupukume. Mema a kalunga akalañana bwa lubumbu koku ne koku.

Kupwa Bene Isalela bāenda panshi pōmu mu dijiba. Kyalombele kitatyi kivule pa kusaka midiyo ya bantu pamo ne banyema bābuke senene bukila bukwabo. Ku mfulo Bene Edipito bāmona monka Bene Isalela. Bapika babo bādi benda bebanyema! Penepa, lubilo lonka bātwela umbukata mwa kalunga, kebebalonda.

Pobātwelele, Leza wākonkola matonto a ku makalo abo. Bene Edipito bāzakala bininge ne kwela ñanji’mba: ‘Yehova webalwila Bene Isalela. Tunyemei muno!’ Ino kyaba kyādi ke kipite.

Ponka’po Yehova wānena Mosesa olole mukombo wandi pa Kalunga Katyila, enka na momwena pano pa kifwatulo’ki. Mosesa pa kolola mukombo, lubumbu lwa mema lwāpomoka, mema āalukila monka moādi ekadile ne kulobeja Bene Edipito ne makalo abo. Bibumbo byonso byālondele Isalela byāfwa mu kalunga ka mema. Kekudipo Mwine Edipito nansha umo wāpandile! Bantu ba Leza bāsepelele kashā pa kupanda! Bana-balume bāimba lwimbo lwa kufwija’ko Yehova’mba: ‘Yehova watambula bushindañani bwa ntumbo. Wāela tubalwe ne batentamine’po mu kalunga ka mema.’ Midiamu, kaka wa Mosesa wāyata luyamba, ne bana-bakaji bonso bāmulonda ne mayamba abo. Abo bonso kebaji na nsangaji, bemba lwimbo lonka lwādi lwimba bana-balume’mba: ‘Yehova watambula bushindañani bwa ntumbo. Wāela tubalwe ne batentamine’po mu kalunga ka mema.’Divilu shapita 12 ku 15. Bipangujo bya Kifundwa
